Maria L.: heads-up — we're seeing a ~12% p50 and ~18% p95 regression on llama3-13b in prod since last night's kernel-selector rollout. dashboard: https://dash/reports/rl-infer/llama3-13b

Ajay (aj): which endpoint / template? any change in input distribution? :eyes:

Maria L.: chat template with long system + conversation prefixes. median seq before was ~220, now a lot of requests ~600. noticed selector moved some requests to a different matmul path after the selector heuristic change (rollout id 2026-03-15-1)

Ken P.: can you paste the model config? also curious if rope_theta or head_dim changed during onboarding. sometimes kernel picker flips when head_dim % 64 hits different branch

Maria L.: config snippet I grabbed from the instance:```
model: llama3-13b
hidden_size: 8192
num_heads: 64
head_dim: 128
norm: RMSNorm
activation: SiLU
rope_theta: 10000.0
```

Zara M.: thanks. two hypotheses: 1) selector now prefers fused_rms_silu kernel for norm+act which increases temp memory and reduces effective batch concurrency for seq>512, and 2) KV-cache memcpy/evict behavior is tripping a slower path when sequence length grows (we saw memcpy spikes before)

Maria L.: perf profile (simple):
```
token_gen_kernel      1.8ms -> 2.2ms  (~22% increase)
kv_copy               0.2ms -> 0.6ms  (spike on seq>512)
cuda_mem_alloc_free   0.05ms -> 0.3ms  (more churn)
```

perf-bot: regression_snapshot: id=rs-20260315-llama3-13b, p50_delta=+11.8, p95_delta=+17.9, note=kernel-selector-rollout

Ajay (aj): try forcing the previous kernel for canary traffic to validate. env override: `RW_KERN_SEL_FORCE=matmul_default` for that model. also try increasing max_batch_tokens to keep larger batches and amortize kv_copy

Maria L.: forced the kernel on a 1% canary — p50 reverted to baseline, p95 improved but still +6%. looks like forcing kernel helps raw matmul but KV side-effects remain.

Ken P.: can we toggle the rope_theta fallback? if we set rope_theta to the previous lower value on the model, the positional interpolation path uses smaller precompute tiling and may reduce kv memcpy sizes. low-risk experiment: set model_override: `rope_theta: 8192` and run microbenchmarks

Zara M.: also add these metrics to the telem for next hour: kv_evictions, kv_memcpy_bytes, active_batch_slots. I suspect we hit a batching fragmentation case when many long chats mix with short ones. batching heuristic should consider seq distribution not just expected arrival rate

Maria L.: agreed. action items: 1) revert selector for canary -> done, 2) run seeded microbench across seq [64,256,512,1024] with both kernel paths -> scheduled, 3) add kv_evictions and kv_memcpy_bytes to per-route telemetry -> ticket created.

runtime-ci: created ticket RW-4672 "llama3-13b kv-copy + kernel-selector perf" and kicked off perf job for seqs [64,256,512,1024]. link: https://ci/runs/4672

Ajay (aj): if microbench shows eviction is culprit we can try these short-term mitigations: a) prefill caching for chat init to avoid repeated kv writes, b) bump max_batch_tokens for the route, c) temporary tweak in selector to prefer matmul_fast for head_dim==128 + RMSNorm+SiLU

Maria L.: thanks all. i'll post results from the microbench and the telemetry in this thread. :thumbsup:
